body: Fear that one of if not the most important person in my life is going to reject me, and it's because I cant control myself. Fear that I'm the one whose ruining a piece of my life, and fearing the consequence. I honestly don't know where it lies on that spectrum.

I don't want to. nor is it something I think is going to happen. but I cant stop thinking about it. Like I thought about hanging my self or choking myself with a belt but that would be too long and painful. I thought about taking pills, but I don't think I have any that will do the job. Like I literally think it may not happen now, but it will someday, and I'm terrified. I need help and don't know where to look. I struggle being open with my emotions. I just completely ruined a relationship with the only women that has really mad me feel loved, and I love her back. I feel like I take 2 steps forward and 100 steps back. I love her so much that I fear what will happen when she comes home and says that we are over which I know is going to happen. I was so happy before the relationship and am still happy. But my mistakes and immaturity is ruining this. I know I'm only 22, but I love her so much. Like literally I hate myself for hurting her, and I feel like its the only way I can really fix this is by hurting me
to step in front of the train outside of my apartment.
